Before we get to the HILLS, comment START to learn step by step how you can create and sell digital products. NOW THE HILLS: 1. Your product doesn’t need more pages. It needs a reason for someone to buy it. A 10-page guide that solves a specific problem can be more useful than a 100-page ebook full of information they could Google. 2. Being good at Canva isn’t enough. I was a graphic designer. Making things pretty was my thing. But you also need to explain who your product is for and why they need it. 3. Creating another product won’t fix avoiding marketing. If nobody knows about the first one, making five more just gives you five more things nobody knows about. 😅 4. You do NOT need to charge $7 just because you’re a beginner. Your experience level isn’t the only thing that determines the value of what you’re selling. 5. AI isn’t cheating. Use it to brainstorm, outline, and create. But review what it gives you. You’re still responsible for the product you put your name on. 6. Posting your offer once isn’t a sales strategy. You saw your post. That doesn’t mean every potential buyer did. Talk about your product again. Show how it works. Give people a reason to care. 7. Digital products can create passive income. Getting them to sell takes work. The product can be delivered while you sleep, but you still have to give people a reason to buy it. Ready to get started?
